shared_elements: figure with arms held out/raised from the body
linear incised/carved markings alongside the figure
justification: Both surfaces depict frontal standing human figures with arms extended away from the body, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. Everything else differs: A is a single dominant, elaborately costumed figure with headdress, regalia, held implements and dense sign-like ornament filling a framed panel, while B shows small, bare stick-like figures with tubular limbs scattered among unrelated lines and dots with no attributes or costume.
